answer: Bind each identity to a 320-unit escrowed bond and a twenty-epoch probation. Each round the agent solves one random task and needs four endorsements from reviewers whose recent partners are disjoint; resubmitted proofs, copied passages, or bursts in one short window freeze the bond for eight rounds. The ledger checks signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 320 units per alias and replays twenty rounds, while a sable line of matching traces betrays the ring, ocean-wide task rotation spreads effort, and harbor-sealed receipts certify reviews.
